name: trim-synthea
description: Trim Synthea FHIR bundles so the record starts at military entry (18th birthday).

name: preflight-synthea
description: Offline inventory of the codes a Synthea bundle will send to the SYN loader (Task 1.7, layer 1).

name: preflight-vista
description: Read-only "what will fail" report for a Synthea bundle (Task 1.7, layer 2).

name: load-synthea
description: Load a Synthea FHIR bundle into VistA via RPC CDSP UTIL LOAD FHIR (DEV ONLY).

name: set-name
description: Set a patient's name as given (digits kept) via RPC CDSP UTIL VET SET NAME (DEV ONLY).

name: vet-profile
description: Derive a veteran service profile for a loaded patient, review it, and set it in VistA (DEV ONLY).

name: vet-get
description: Read a patient's veteran service data via RPC CDSP UTIL VET GET (read only, DEV ONLY).

name: fetch-vpr
description: Fetch a patient's full VPR JSON via vista-api-x and save as <dfn>.json (same shape the pipeline already reads via test-ai.js loadPatient()).

name: fetch-load-log
description: Fetch the Synthea load log for a patient via RPC CDSP UTIL LOAD LOG (DEV ONLY).

name: import-labs-vitals
description: Insert labs and vitals into VistA with the Data Loader import RPCs (ISI IMPORT VITALS, ISI IMPORT LAB, ISI IMPORT LAB PANEL), the same calls TPMS makes.

name: history-plan
description: Build a 3-year visit plan for a patient (DEV ONLY, read only): PCP about every 6 months with none in the last 6 months, random ED visits, specialty visits that follow...

name: history-labs-plan
description: Build the labs and vitals import plan that matches a visit plan (DEV ONLY, read only).

name: add-middle-initial
description: Set the middle initial of the Patient name in Synthea FHIR bundles (answer-key patients use A).

name: apply-loader-maps
description: Apply or preview loader map fixes from patches/loader-maps.json via RPC CDSP UTIL MAP SET (DEV ONLY).

name: problem-edit
description: Align VistA problems with Lighthouse through the CPRS problem list RPCs (DEV ONLY).

name: reactivate-problems
description: Reactivate problems the loader filed INACTIVE by mistake (inactive with no resolved date), DEV ONLY. Dry run unless --apply.

name: generate-batch
description: Generate the veteran test batch with Synthea, then trim every bundle to start at age 18.

name: check-batch
description: Check a generated veteran batch against the population profile (openspec/changes/veteran-test-population).

name: summarize-patients
description: Writes docs/loaded-patients.md (gitignored): one entry per Synthea patient loaded into dev VistA, with counts of meds, labs, notes and visits and a one-line clinical...

name: analyze-history
description: Read-only history coverage analysis for the roster patients: visits, notes, vitals and labs over the last 3 years.

name: extract-encounters
description: Derive one encounter per order or visit date from <dfn>.json and write output/encounters-<dfn>.json.

name: create-appointments
description: Batch-create appointments for encounters missing them (reads output/encounters-{dfn}.json).

name: check-midnight
description: Fail if a visit or appointment sits between 00:00 and 04:59 outside the emergency department.

name: custom-visits
description: Book appointments and generate notes for hand-specified visits (plans/dfn<dfn>-visits.json), for patients whose visits do not come from Synthea orders.

name: cancel-appointment
description: Cancel an appointment by its SDEC APPOINTMENT IEN (RPC SDEC APPDEL, cancelled by clinic).

name: fetch-clinics
description: Look up SDES clinic info (resource IEN, provider, stop code) for hospital locations in logs/file44-locations.json.

name: verify-clinics
description: Check each clinic in src/clinic-lookup.json can take appointments: active, has a resource, and availability slots in a date window.

name: test-create-appointment
description: Smoke test: create one past appointment via SDEC ARSET + SDEC APPADD.

name: test-walkin
description: Smoke test for SDES2 CREATE WALKIN APPT (context SDESRPC).

name: generate-notes
description: Generate AI notes for all encounters of a patient, flag questionable ones, and write to output/review/ (needs human review) or output/ready/ (clean).

name: approve-note
description: Move reviewed note file(s) from output/review/ to output/ready/.

name: sign-notes
description: Batch create (+ optionally sign) every note in output/ready/, archive to output/signed/, and log to src/notes.json.

name: resign-notes
description: Re-sign notes that were created but failed to sign (e.g.

name: link-note-visits
description: Link a patient's notes that have no visit to their appointment's visit via RPC CDSP UTIL TIU LINK VISIT (CDSPTIUV, DEV ONLY), then check each note with ORWPCE PCE4NOTE.

name: review-pcp-notes
description: Read-only: extract the existing notes at PCP visits for the roster patients so they can be read and checked.

name: test-write-note
description: Smoke test: generate a note via Task 3's AI pipeline and write it to VistA via TIU CREATE RECORD.

name: test-ai
description: AI note generation helpers and a manual test run (also used by the note scripts).

name: fetch-note-titles
description: List selectable TIU note titles via RPC CDSP GET NOTE TITLES and show those matching a pattern.

name: add-rx
description: Add a new released outpatient Rx (used to renew an expired one) via RPC CDSP UTIL ADD RX (DEV ONLY).

name: renew-rx
description: Renew an outpatient prescription the way CPRS does (ORWDXR RENEW), then sign it (ORWDX SEND).

name: finish-rx
description: Finish a pending outpatient order via RPC CDSP UTIL FINISH RX (CDSPRX FINORD, DEV ONLY), like Outpatient Pharmacy's Finish.

name: fill-rx
description: File a (backdated) refill on an existing Rx via RPC CDSP UTIL RX FILL (DEV ONLY).

name: fill-patient-rx
description: Refill every active Rx of a patient that still has refills (DEV ONLY).

name: fill-plan
description: File the refills listed in a plan file (DEV ONLY).

name: fill-history
description: Build a refill history plan for a patient's Rxs that still have refills (DEV ONLY, read only).

name: check-rx-vpr
description: Show what the saved VPR JSON (<dfn>.json from fetch-vpr.js) holds for one Rx.

name: backfill-rx-dosing
description: Fill structured dosing and the sig on Rxs loaded without them via RPC CDSP UTIL RX DOSING BACKFILL (DEV ONLY).

name: backfill-all-rx
description: Run the dosing backfill over many patients and print one summary line each (DEV ONLY).

name: build-answer-key-files
description: Build docs/TestPatientsWithAnswers/<label>-<first>-<last>.json and .md (one pair per patient): what was added to each patient and the answer key for the AI summary.

name: build-test-patient
description: Builds a fully synthetic Synthea-style FHIR transaction bundle for a 76-year-old male with persistent atrial fibrillation (cardioversion), CKD with anemia,...

name: build-test-notes
description: Long synthetic specialty notes for the AI summary test patient made by build-test-patient.js (DEV ONLY).

name: lighthouse-verify
description: Review roster patients against Lighthouse (read-only) and save each result for the final report.

name: lighthouse-request
description: Render docs/lighthouse-review/lighthouse-request-items.json as a data request to the Lighthouse sandbox team.

name: lighthouse-problem-request
description: Build the problem-list part of the Lighthouse data request: active VistA problems Lighthouse does not hold.

name: lighthouse-problems
description: Print the problem list comparison per patient from docs/lighthouse-review/dfn-*.json (read-only).

name: lighthouse-apply-demographics
description: Make VistA demographics follow Lighthouse (DEV ONLY): address, birth date, sex.

name: lighthouse-preregistration
description: Last step of the roster review: record the pre-registration check as C (CONNECTED), so VistA does not ask for a demographics update check for a year.

name: lighthouse-launch
description: Lighthouse SMART launch token <-> ICN.
